#define tau 6.28318
float yResolution = 10.0; // amount of vectors in one column
float scrollSpeed = 5.0; // how fast the screen scrolls

float rand( vec2 co ) { // function for generating a random number that i found online
    return fract(sin(dot(co, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
}

vec2 thetaToXY( float theta ) { // converts a unit vector's angle to an XY coordinate
    return vec2(cos(theta), sin(theta));
}

float sstep( float t ) { // smoothstep function
    return 3.0*t*t - 2.0*t*t*t;
}

void mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord ) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord/iResolution.y*yResolution + vec2(scrollSpeed*iTime, 0.0); // x = 0.0 - ~1.778, y = 0.0 - 1.0
    
    vec2 blCorner = floor(uv);                        //-,
    vec2 brCorner = vec2( ceil(uv.x) , floor(uv.y) ); // |-each of the 4 corners of the cell
    vec2 tlCorner = vec2( floor(uv.x) , ceil(uv.y) ); // |
    vec2 trCorner = ceil(uv);                         //-'
    
    vec2 blVector = thetaToXY( rand( blCorner )*tau ); //-,
    vec2 brVector = thetaToXY( rand( brCorner )*tau ); // |-creating 4 vectors based on those corners
    vec2 tlVector = thetaToXY( rand( tlCorner )*tau ); // |
    vec2 trVector = thetaToXY( rand( trCorner )*tau ); //-'
    
    vec2 blOffset = uv - blCorner; //-,
    vec2 brOffset = uv - brCorner; // |-calculating the offset vectors
    vec2 tlOffset = uv - tlCorner; // |
    vec2 trOffset = uv - trCorner; //-'
    
    float blDotProduct = dot(blOffset, blVector); //-,
    float brDotProduct = dot(brOffset, brVector); // |-calculating the dot products of the offset vectors and the normal vectors
    float tlDotProduct = dot(tlOffset, tlVector); // |
    float trDotProduct = dot(trOffset, trVector); //-'
    
    float mix1 = mix(blDotProduct, brDotProduct, sstep(blOffset.x)); //-,
    float mix2 = mix(tlDotProduct, trDotProduct, sstep(blOffset.x)); // |-calculating the linear interpolation of the dot products
    float mix3 = mix(mix1, mix2, sstep(blOffset.y));                 //-'
    
    fragColor = vec4( vec3((mix3+1.0)/2.0) , 1.0 ); // final output
}
